newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - UK February retail price data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - UK February retail price data.

text.p: Following is a selection of economists' reactions to data showing underlying inflation falling to 2.9 percent in February from 3.1 in January.
"If anything the numbers are slightly better than the market was looking for. They will take some of te heat off the Chancellor after the very strong figures we saw yesterday."
"The figures are pretty much in line. I think people were still a little bit nervous after yesterday and there may be a sigh of relief in the markets now."
"Core inflation benefited in February from the effects of the strong currency on import prices plus a smaller price rebound following the January sales than last February."

"Yesterday's earnings data though remain something of a dark cloud for inflation going forward. Unless higher nominal earnings can be matched by productivity growth, strong domestic demand will result in higher inflation later this year."
